config.metric: P(fixation to all-up) = fraction of runs ending all-1
config.update: asynchronous voter: pick random agent i, pick random OTHER agent j (j!=i, complete graph), set opinion[i]=opinion[j]; N updates = 1 sweep; run to absorbing all-0/all-1; each update reads only the two agents' local opinions

analytic_anchors.magnetization: mean final magnetization = 2u-1 (conserved in expectation; the up-count is a bounded martingale under the symmetric copy rule)
analytic_anchors.note: anchors are the mean-field theory, not fit to the run

verdicts.label: P1
verdicts.gate: P1 every run reaches absorbing consensus (consensus rate = 1.0 at every u)

verdicts.label: P2
verdicts.gate: P2 P(all-up) within +/-0.07 of u for every u in [0.2, 0.5, 0.8]

verdicts.label: P3
verdicts.gate: P3 mean final magnetization within +/-0.1 of 2u-1 for every u
